blurb: Camp Beer Co. is a brewery and tasting room in Langley, BC, focused on creating a welcoming community space. Guests can enjoy award-winning craft beers, food, and events like live music and trivia nights. The taproom offers a variety of beers, cocktails, and non-alcoholic options, with a family-friendly environment including a kids menu.
extraNote: No reservations except for groups of 10 or more · No outside food allowed · Taproom at 110-19664 64 Ave, Langley, BC
